description: B04: Comparison of F0 cascades across four routing signals and two System-2 backends, fixing primary 1-p1 escalation masks

holdout.reason: Holdout is strictly forbidden from being loaded or evaluated during B04.

generation_parameters.reason: B04 computes cascaded decisions using pre-collected B02 Jev and F0 predictions; no new LLM queries are dispatched.

acceptance_criteria: All 8 routing/backend combinations evaluated across calibration and selection dev pools
Budget points q in {0.15, 0.25, 0.35} evaluated with ceil(q * N_total)
Mask nesting M_15 subset M_25 subset M_35 verified across all datasets and roles
Primary handoff mask strictly uses 1-p1 signal, invariant across System-2 backends and performance outcomes
CLINC150 sorts ID and OOS together in a mixed pool; ANLI sorts R2 and R3 together
Cascaded predictions inherit Jev application output for unrouted samples, replace with F0 for routed samples
Net gain identity (Corrected - Damaged == Cascaded correct - Jev correct) holds exactly
Primary 35% mask union contains exactly 975 dev pool samples (650 calibration + 325 selection)
Zero external API calls ($0.00 USD cost) and zero holdout data accessed
